the identification, relative quantification and functional characterization of the brain tissue proteomes of wild type and AD mice under B vitamin deficiency and control diets.
the investigation of the brain tissue proteomes of AD model mice fed with control diet or deficient in B vitamins by a LC-MS top- down platform.

the identification of proteins and peptides and their relative quantification by top-down proteomics analysis of the acid soluble fraction of brain tissue of TcGRND8 model mice under B vitamins deficient diet.

the B vitamin deficient diet induces changes on the proteome of the brain tissue that could be related to the pathogenesis of LOAD.

the LC-MS topdown proteomics approach is an efficient tool to investigate AD, especially in combination with the use of animal models and dietary manipulation.
metallothionein and brain acid soluble proteins are potential biomarkers of the AD process and of its modulation by B vitamins.

the LC-MS top- down proteomics approach is a useful and promising technique to investigate the brain tissue proteomics of AD.
